name: SoundHub
author: osia
description: One audio hub for the bar: a spinning-record now playing view for any MPRIS player, live spectrum, Omarchy's sound controls (devices, volumes, per-app mix) and a live PipeWire equalizer. Follows the Omarchy theme.

barWidget.description: Live spectrum in the bar (wheel/middle click: style, right click: colours); click for now playing, sound devices, per-app volume and the equalizer.
